status: Proposed bounded implementation; rendered benefit is not yet established
purpose: Spatial consistency: make the authored investigation attend to its actual question after the same scene stacks on a phone.
cause: The phone heading is above and only slightly right of the neutral eye center, while authored reading gaze remains to the right and includes positive/downward gazeY.
implementation: Add a pure staging helper loaded only by signature.html. Measure neutral eye midpoint from the SVG viewBox fit and the question heading rectangle, once initially and on ResizeObserver/window/font layout changes. Do not read layout during character frames.

Derive an upper-target influence continuously from the measured direction, not a phone/user-agent branch. Apply only to curious-investigate and curious-wry, through their unchanged150–2350ms attention window. The24-expression studio and original curious control are untouched.

Use measured gaze bearing with a reduced authored scan; preserve decisive upward reading when the question is above. Add modest head support after gaze: reduce lateral headX/headR and use headY*.25-3 for the strongly-above case. Body, limbs, glasses and all anatomy stay authored.
Adjustment fades fully to zero by2350ms, preserving the exact warm visitor return and offering gesture. Both themes use the same mapped pose; theme change does not recalculate or reset staging.

Cache and smoothly retarget layout direction during an existing playback using the existing380ms pose-transition scale. Paused/inspection frames stay frozen until the next explicit playback/inspection action. Reduced motion never starts a new animation.
Preserve the current scene order and300px phone host. Do not compact the intro absent rendered evidence of a separate benefit. Format signature.js and add focused pure mapping tests.
